description: This file defines the KmsMaterialsProvider class, which provides methods for encrypting and decrypting data using AWS KMS, including handling of encryption envelopes and material descriptions. It supports legacy encryption workflows and interacts with AWS KMS via the KmsClient.

classes.name: KmsMaterialsProvider
classes.description: A legacy class that supplies encryption materials using AWS KMS, supporting older encryption workflows and integrating with AWS SDK's KmsClient.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with a KmsClient instance and an optional KMS key ID.

methods.name: fromDecryptionEnvelope
methods.description: Creates a new provider instance from a decryption envelope, extracting materials description and KMS key ID.

methods.name: getMaterialsDescription
methods.description: Returns the materials description containing the KMS key ID.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Returns the name of the wrap algorithm used, which is 'kms'.

methods.name: encryptCek
methods.description: Encrypts a content encryption key (CEK) using AWS KMS's Encrypt API and returns the encrypted key encoded in base64.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted CEK using AWS KMS's Decrypt API and returns the plaintext key.
